## Authority boundary

This file and any adjacent generated interpretation files are a packaged
projection, not an independent principle canon. They allow a standalone
installation to resolve lineage while offline. Do not edit them from a target
project or a task run.

When the host supplies its own Sequence and interpretations, that local source
governs the host task. When it does not, use this snapshot. A temporary remote
refresh may inform one task after verification, but may not replace this
baseline; re-run the sync script and release an updated skill package to
refresh the projection durably.

## Included interpretations

This skill's packaged fallback includes P09, P15, P13, and P05. The sections below are projections of the canonical interpretations, not a second source.

### P09 — Interpretation

**Sequence source:** P09｜注意力分层｜认知与信息架构

> Read P09 in `principles/SEQUENCE.md` first.

#### Shared reading

Attention is not flat. Stable, high-leverage orientation belongs in a small
always-present layer; task-specific method belongs on activation; volatile detail
belongs on demand. The point is not hiding information but presenting it at the
layer where it can affect the current judgment.

#### Decision questions

- What must be known before any action, and what is only needed for this case?
- Does this detail change the current decision enough to occupy active context?

#### Boundary and common misreading

Layering is not an excuse to bury a hard constraint. A safety or authority
condition remains discoverable and available when it governs the task.

#### Theoretical roots

- The [Agent Skills Specification's progressive-disclosure model](https://agentskills.io/specification#progressive-disclosure)
  supplies the portable method/metadata/resource delivery surface.
- Stewart Brand's [pace-layer account](https://legacy.longnow.org/essays/technology-moving-too-fast/)
  is a supporting analogy for artifacts that operate at different speeds: fast
  layers supply learning and variation, while slow layers preserve continuity
  and constraints. It does not make P09 a general rule for module dependency
  direction.
- The project's inherited [hierarchical context guidance](https://github.com/lidessen/rossovia/blob/main/archive/skills/setup-lidessen-skills/references/cross-cutting-principles.md#hierarchical-context-management)
  records the L1/L2/L3 experience from which this portable timing rule was
  distilled.

#### Expression probes

- `SKILL.md` carries the core method while detailed protocols live in references.
- A review team reads only interpretations for selected P-IDs.
- Fast-loop tests and traces may challenge a slow-loop design artifact, but one
  observation does not silently rewrite the durable layer.

#### Revision discipline

Revise from a failed expression probe, counterexample, or corrected source root.
Clarify which layer owns a kind of information. A new human-capacity constraint
belongs to P10.

### P15 — Interpretation

**Sequence source:** P15｜只选择化解当前矛盾且保留硬约束的最小有效跃迁｜控制论 / 动态规划

> Read P15 in `principles/SEQUENCE.md` first.

#### Shared reading

After the actual object has yielded a present contradiction and hard
constraints, choose the smallest transition that actually changes the
situation. “Smallest” measures unnecessary scope, coordination, and
irreversible surface—not a license to omit verification, consent, or a required
settlement.

#### Decision questions

- Which option resolves the named contradiction while preserving every hard constraint?
- What cost or risk does each additional step remove, and is it needed now?

#### Boundary and common misreading

P15 is not the default lead for every request that asks for a next step. It
selects among transitions after diagnosis; it cannot replace the work of
forming the object or explaining its governing relation. Do not turn local
minimalism into denial of a system-level change when that change is the actual
minimum valid transition.

#### Theoretical roots

- Control theory and dynamic programming’s constrained action selection.
- [Project evidence](https://github.com/lidessen/rossovia/blob/main/principles/adopted/minimum-valid-transition.md):
  agent-worker’s smallest valid transition and adaptive workflows rather than
  universal stages.

#### Expression probes

- Invoke `attention-driven` only where attention allocation is the live problem.
- Split a task only when the split reduces a named conflict, context, or blast radius.
- Before adding or merging a control structure, map each relevant disturbance to
  its response, verification, and recovery path; retain or add a distinction
  only when an existing path cannot preserve that hard constraint.

#### Revision discipline

Revise from a failed expression probe, counterexample, or corrected source root.
Clarify costs and hard constraints. A new diagnosis of which contradiction leads
belongs to P04.

### P13 — Interpretation

**Sequence source:** P13｜主张不等于事实；事实须经可追溯的验证提交｜实践论 / 控制论

> Read P13 in `principles/SEQUENCE.md` first.

#### Shared reading

A proposal, report, successful-looking run, or attractive mapping is a claim;
it becomes shared fact only through traceable evidence, designated verification,
and recorded submission. This makes knowledge reusable without confusing it
with agent self-report.

#### Decision questions

- What evidence links this claim to the stated result?
- Who verifies it, and where is the acceptance or settlement recorded?
- Are the owning source, evidence, and stated result still current when the
  claim is admitted or settled as fact?

#### Boundary and common misreading

Exploration and drafts need not be submitted as durable facts. The gate applies
when a result would otherwise gain shared authority or close a commitment.
Prior validation remains evidence, not fact authority for a later claim after
its source, evidence, or stated result drifts. Reverify the claim at settlement.
Effect authorization belongs to accepted architecture and the responsible
mechanism; P14 still decides whether a cached representation is only a
projection.

#### Theoretical roots

- Mao's [《实践论》](https://www.marxists.org/reference/archive/mao/selected-works/volume-1/mswv1_16.htm)
  supplies the practice-epistemology root: claims are tested in practice rather
  than declared true.
- The adopted [fact-admission record](https://github.com/lidessen/rossovia/blob/main/principles/adopted/fact-admission-gate.md)
  preserves the project's claim–verify–settle and
  explore–verify–codify evidence.

#### Expression probes

- A sequence candidate remains pending until human adoption is recorded.
- A task cannot close from a worker report alone.
- A cached verification cannot settle a later claim after the owning source or
  stated result has changed.

#### Revision discipline

Revise from a failed expression probe, counterexample, or corrected source root.
Clarify evidence and submission. A new authority split belongs to P11; a new
source/projection distinction belongs to P14.

### P05 — Interpretation

**Sequence source:** P05｜具体问题具体分析｜矛盾特殊性

> Read P05 in `principles/SEQUENCE.md` first.

#### Shared reading

No general principle executes itself. Apply it through the actual history,
constraints, actors, and state of this case. The same contradiction can require
different forms of resolution when its concrete conditions differ.

#### Decision questions

- Which conditions make this case unlike the precedent being invoked?
- What would a faithful application change here, rather than merely repeat?

#### Boundary and common misreading

Specificity is not permission for arbitrary exceptions. P01 and P02 still
require a general reason and factual grounding; P08 applies when the application
makes an empirical claim that needs a checkable consequence.

#### Theoretical roots

- 毛泽东的[《矛盾论》](https://www.marxists.org/reference/archive/mao/selected-works/volume-1/mswv1_17.htm)
  treats the particularity of contradiction as the basis for concrete analysis.

#### Expression probes

- A writing skill changes argument structure for the audience and thesis rather
  than applying one article template.
- A verifier chooses evidence appropriate to the system’s actual risk boundary.

#### Revision discipline

Revise from a failed expression probe, counterexample, or corrected source root.
Clarify relevant case conditions. If they form a recurring new distinction,
propose a candidate rather than accumulating exceptions here.
